title: Vortex shedding behind a circular cylinder, Re = 100

source.citation: C. H. K. Williamson, Vortex dynamics in the cylinder wake, Annu. Rev. Fluid Mech. 28, 477-539 (1996), for the shedding regime; the ranges below are the spread of published two-dimensional computations at Re = 100.
source.note: Unlike the other two cases there is no single accepted number here. Published two-dimensional simulations at Re = 100 give a mean drag coefficient between about 1.32 and 1.38 and a Strouhal number between about 0.164 and 0.167, the spread coming from domain size, blockage and how long the average was taken over. A result is judged against the range, not against a point.

agreement.note: Inside the range counts as agreement. Outside it, the distance from the nearer end is reported; a value outside is not automatically wrong, but it needs the domain and the averaging window looked at.
